title: Slic3r CLI adapter config
description: Configuration for original Slic3r (the upstream of PrusaSlicer/SuperSlicer). Safe probe uses --help only.

exe_path.description: Absolute path to slic3r-console.exe, slic3r.exe, or slic3r binary.

version.description: Detected version string from --help output, e.g. '1.3.0'.

cli_supported.description: True when Slic3r supports --help and --export-gcode CLI flags.
